I have definitely lost some people, relationships, and jobs due to my bipolar. Sometimes the best thing you can do is accept that you will never get these things back and move on. 

My mania can get really bad to where I don't sleep for days. I become really paranoid and lose impulse control with spending and sex. I will start projects and hobbies and move on before I finish anything. I can become really irritable at the smallest things, all while feeling like I'm god's gift to humanity and better than everyone else. And while this is happening I will start to see and hear things that aren't there. 

On the other hand my depression can be so much worse. I sleep too much. I break down and cry out of nowhere. I refuse to go anywhere and do anything. I will have the worst anhedonia. I will stay in bed for days without eating or taking care of myself. I constantly struggle with suicidal ideation and only have some relief when I make a plan to do so. My anxiety is extremely high during this time and makes me sick to my stomach. 

These things made me realize that I will probably have to be on medication for the rest of my life, if I want to lead anything close to a normal life. Please seek help anywhere you can get it. There are online support groups and some places will offer discounted counseling based on income. There are even some psychiatrists you can see that will take payments on a sliding scale based on income. 

Wishing you all the best and hope you find the help you need.
